notes: Guard added: platform/ci/check_map_callback_args.py (+test), run on every ventures PR via unwired_checks.py. First run on main: 3 hits (the 2 home-inspection call sites and quote-margin-check row.map(csvCell), the latter harmless and now wrapped). A naive name-based prototype gave 30 hits with mostly false positives; restricting to top-level definitions and a non-index-shaped second parameter cut it to the real ones. Verification: node --test home-inspection 34/34, campground 26/26, quote-margin-check site 136/136; unittest 4 OK; browser check of the home-inspection page before (pageerror, no report) and after (report built, ignored cost named).

real_defects.issue: summarize() and the page's build() called findings.map(normalise), so normalise(f, issues) got the array index as issues: a negative or non-numeric repair cost on the 2nd+ finding threw 'issues.push is not a function' from Build the report and Download as text (reproduced in Chromium), and on the 1st finding the repair note was dropped silently.
Below break-even occupancy the findings said both 'loses about $16,385 a year' and 'One rainy month can turn it into a loss' (sample inputs at 35% full). Now states the gap in occupied nights.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: mutation triage of two calculators, two bug fixes with tests and browser check, a repo-wide lint with tests, a post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
